dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Diabetic ketoacidosis (DKA) secondary to uncontrolled type 1 or insulin-dependent type 2 diabetes mellitus

Alternatives to consider:
1. Hyperosmolar hyperglycemic state (HHS) secondary to type 2 diabetes mellitus
2. Uremic syndrome from advanced chronic kidney disease (diabetic/hypertensive nephropathy)
3. Acute metabolic decompensation with electrolyte derangement (severe hyponatremia or hyperkalemia) from chronic kidney disease
